name: @wellwineo/pi-secret-guard
description: Secret guard redacts configured values and common credential patterns in input, tool results and provider request payloads where supported. Configure references, not secret values, in `~/.pi/agent/secret-guard.json` (override with `PI_SECRET_GUARD_CONFIG`
